name: radarr-control
description: Full control of a Radarr movie manager instance (v3+ REST API) from Claude Code. Bundles an MCP server authenticated with a Radarr API key (X-Api-Key header), exposing both a generic passthrough reaching every /api/v3 endpoint and curated tools for status, library (list/get/lookup/add/update/delete movie, collections, movie files), wanted missing/cutoff, calendar, queue, history, commands (search/refresh/rescan), quality profiles, root folders, tags, custom formats, notifications, download clients, indexers, import lists, blocklist, logs, system tasks & backups. Writes are confirm-gated. Tested against Radarr 6.3.0.10514.
